1170-2510-8210.notablePrerequisites: There is a sorcery card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
1170-2510-8210.description:
Cast a copy of Soul Tether by paying {R/G}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Konstrari Improviser. It'll enter prepared due to its effect.
Resolve Soul Tether, creating a Heartwood token.
Activate the Heartwood by tapping it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat.

792-2946-4871-6797.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
792-2946-4871-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Totentanz trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2781-4617-4906-6084-7487.notablePrerequisites:
You control your commander.
You have not activated Soulbright Flamekin's ability more than twice this turn.
2781-4617-4906-6084-7487.description:
Activate Soulbright Flamekin by paying {2}, targeting Agrus Kos.
Agrus Kos triggers, causing you to pay {1}{R/W} to copy Soulbright Flamekin's ability targeting each other creature you control.
Resolve all Soulbright Flamekin triggers, giving the targeted creatures trample until end of turn and adding eight {R}.
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying {3}{W}.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Agrus Kos.
Agrus Kos triggers, causing you to pay {1}{R/W} to copy Felidar Guardian's trigger, targeting each other creature you control except Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the copies of Felidar Guardian's trigger targeting Soulbright Flamekin and Zealous Lorecaster, blinking Soulbright Flamekin and Zealous Lorecaster.
When Zealous Lorecaster enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Deflecting Swat from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate Soulbright Flamekin by paying {2}, targeting Agrus Kos.
Agrus Kos triggers, causing you to pay {1}{R/W} to copy Soulbright Flamekin's ability targeting each other creature you control.
Resolve all Soulbright Flamekin triggers, giving the targeted creatures trample until end of turn and adding eight {R}.
Cast Deflecting Swat by paying {0}, changing any of the remaining Felidar Guardian triggers not targeting Agrus Kos to target Agrus Kos instead.
Repeat from step 6.

240-969-5470-5686.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token
Repeat from step 2.

3490-4289-4742-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
3490-4289-4742-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

2511-4871-5220-5447.notablePrerequisites:
You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
You have solved Case of the Locked Hothouse.
2511-4871-5220-5447.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

343-1879-2366-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
343-1879-2366-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Regal Behemoth triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Aang, Swift Savior // Aang and La, Ocean's Fury

1796-6867-7043.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}.
When Appa enters, it triggers, airbending Aang
Cast Aang from exile by paying {0}.
Appa triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When Aang enters, it triggers, airbending Appa.
Cast Appa from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat from step 2.

3490-5231-6720-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-5231-6720-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers, causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Spider-Man trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

1170-2196-2701-6991.easyPrerequisites: You control up to three lands that can tap to produce at least {U}.
1170-2196-2701-6991.description:
Cast Dark Ritual by paying {B}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Donnie & April.
When Donnie & April enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Frantic Search from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Dark Ritual, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate up to three lands by tapping them, adding at least {U}.
Cast Frantic Search by paying {2}{B}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Donnie & April.
When Donnie & April enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Dark Ritual from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Frantic Search, causing you to loot twice and untap up to three lands.
Repeat.

1651-1863-6751-6754-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1651-1863-6751-6754-6756.notablePrerequisites: Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1651-1863-6751-6754-6756.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Eusocial Engineering triggers twice due to Starfield Vocalist, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

1170-1329-3518-6633.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by discarding your hand and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1894-5220-5931-6900.notablePrerequisites:
Funeral Room is unlocked.
Gwenom has attacked this turn.
1894-5220-5931-6900.description:
Activate Bile Urchin by sacrificing it.
When Bile Urchin dies, Mortuary and Funeral Room trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Bile Urchin from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Funeral Room trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Bile Urchin ability.
Cast Bile Urchin from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

821-1829-2173-5220.description:
Activate Mogg Fanatic by sacrificing it.
When Mogg Fanatic dies, Mortuary and Vindictive Vampire trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Mogg Fanatic from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Vindictive Vampire trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Mogg Fanatic ability.
Cast Mogg Fanatic from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

478-552-6871.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six basic Swamps.
478-552-6871.description:
Activate Cabal Stronghold by paying {3} and tapping it, adding {B} for each basic Swamp you control.
Activate Candelabra of Tawnos by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Cabal Stronghold and Candelabra of Tawnos as it is a land due to Toph.
Repeat.

934-3670-4508.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
934-3670-4508.description:
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
Ingenious Artillerist triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, as Ingenious Artillerist is a Pirate due to Amorphous Axe, creating a Treasure token for each opponent dealt damage this way.
When the Treasure(s) enter, Ingenious Artillerist triggers that many times.
Resolve the first Ingenious Artillerist trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 3.

413-1263-2060-6701.description:
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodsoaked Champion enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion is sacrificed, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.
413-1263-2060-6701.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana needed to activate the creature's ability from your graveyard.

1548-2511-3719-6307--85.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least seven creatures, excluding Port Razer, that have total power 1 or greater.
An opponent cannot block and kill Port Razer or Luxurious Locomotive.
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
1548-2511-3719-6307--85.description:
Activate Luxurious Locomotive's crew ability by tapping seven creatures you control with total power 1 or greater, causing Luxurious Locomotive to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Declare Luxurious Locomotive and Port Raazer as attackers, triggering Luxurious Locomotive, creating at least seven Treasure tokens.
Deal combat damage using Port Razer, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Port Razer.
Resolve the Port Razer ability, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{B}.
Activate Ruthless Technomancer by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing four Treasures, returning Port Razer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with at least two +1/+1 counters on it

3693-4120-5934.notablePrerequisites: There are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard.
3693-4120-5934.description:
Activate Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.
Activate Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Repeat as desired.
3693-4120-5934.notes: You may target a creature you control in step 2 to put +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.

1329-1778-2178-2829.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-1778-2178-2829.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Memnite from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Memnite from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Memnite.
When Memnite dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Repeat.

864-1309-1987-4276.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
864-1309-1987-4276.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Salvager of Secrets and Eternal Witness.
When Salvager of Secrets and Eternal Witness enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
864-1309-1987-4276.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

729-1812-2440-4183.notablePrerequisites:
Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
{U}{R} available, plus an additional {U}{R} if you control less than three creatures that share a creature type with Great Oak Guardian
729-1812-2440-4183.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Great Oak Guardian with haste.
When the token Great Oak Guardian enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Great Oak Guardian trigger, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +2/+2 until end of turn.
Holding priority, if you control less than four creatures that share a creature type with Great Oak Guardian, repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time.
Resolve all Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with Great Oak Guardian for each trigger resolved this way.
Activate Prismite twice by paying {4}, adding {U}{R}.
Repeat.

1247-1336-5963.notablePrerequisites: Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
1247-1336-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Heronblade Elite's ability by tapping it, adding at least two mana of any color.
Activate Marvin using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

511-817-1270-3921-4050.description:
Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}, putting two spore counters on a Fungus you control.
Activate a Fungus by removing two spore counters from it, creating three 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Saprolings, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

2556-5232-5718.description:
Cast Clone Legion by paying {7}{U}{U}, causing you to create a token copy of Hidetsugu and Kairi and Mnemonic Wall.
Put the token Hidetsugu and Kairi into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Hidetsugu and Kairi token's first and second abilities trigger, as well as Mnemonic Wall.
Resolve the Mnemonic Wall trigger, returning Clone Legion from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the first Hidetsugu and Kairi trigger, causing you to draw three cards and then put Clone Legion and another card on top of your library, ensuring Clone Legion is on top.
Resolve the second Hidetsugu and Kairi trigger, exiling Clone Legion from the top of your library, then causing an opponent to lose 9 life and allowing you to cast Clone Legion from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Clone Legion, causing you to create a token copy of Hidetsugu and Kairi and Mnemonic Wall.
Repeat from step 2.

962-2713-2816.notablePrerequisites:
Umbral Mantle attached to Yurlok of Scorch Thrash.
Yurlok of Scorch Thrash does not have summoning sickness.
962-2713-2816.description:
Activate Yurlok of Scorch Thrash by paying {1} and tapping it, causing each player to add {B}{R}{G}
Activate Yurlok of Scorch Thrash by paying {1} and untapping it, causing itself to get +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat an arbitrarily large amount of times.
It is strongly recommended to empty your mana pool using a mana sink before proceeding.
Move to your next step or phase, causing each player to lose life equal to the amount of unspent mana in their mana pool.
Each player whose mana pool contained an amount of mana equal to or greater than their life total loses the game due to having 0 or less life, which causes a draw if every player lost the game.

uses.n: Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life

1993-4543-5536.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one land card in hand.
Rex does not have summoning sickness.
Trench Behemoth and Budoka Gardener exiled with brain counters on them.
1993-4543-5536.description:
Activate Rex using Budoka Gardener's ability by tapping it, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
If the land is mana-producing and enters the battlefield untapped, you may activate it by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Rex using Trench Behemoth's ability by returning the land from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Rex.
Repeat.

338-678-2060-2123-4050.notablePrerequisites: Light of Promise attached to Crystalline Crawler.
338-678-2060-2123-4050.description:
Cast Kokusho by paying {4}{B}{B}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Kokusho, adding {B}.
When Kokusho dies, it and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Kokusho from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Kokusho trigger, causing each opponent to lose 5 life and you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.
Crystalline Crawler triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the life you gained.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability five times by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {4}{B}.
Repeat.

876-1171-1409.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Garth One-Eye.
876-1171-1409.description:
Activate Garth One-Eye by tapping it, choosing Black Lotus.
Cast the copy of Black Lotus.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing itself, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Garth One-Eye by paying {1}{U}, exiling and returning onto the battlefield.
Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Garth One-Eye.
Activate Lightning Greaves's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Garth One-Eye.
Repeat.

1271-3212-4872.description:
Tap Scroll Rack and pay {1} to activate it, putting Time Warp on top of your library.
Pass the turn.
On your next draw step, when you draw Time Warp, reveal it due to Kefnet's ability, making a copy that costs {2} less to cast.
Cast the copy for {1}{U}{U}, granting you an extra turn.
